name: Harvard Museum of Natural History
source: Wikimedia Commons photos taken in the galleries; floor plan from the HMSC wayfinding brochure
note: Harvard’s natural history collections hold over 21 million specimens; a small part is on view. The museum’s website and databases can’t be read by this guide, so listed here are things visitors photographed in the galleries and shared with a free licence, in the gallery where they are shown. Photos are of different years, so a few may have moved.
